Title: App crashes on startup after upgrade
Body:
The app crashes on boot.

arguments.body:
Thanks for the report. This issue needs more information before it can be triaged or reproduced.

Please provide:
- The full crash log / stack trace (from logcat, Crashlytics, or the OS crash reporter).
- App version and build number where the crash occurs, and whether it happens on a fresh install or only after upgrading from an earlier version.
- Device/OS info (Android version, manufacturer, or iOS version / device model).
- Steps to reproduce, if the crash is not immediate on every boot.
- Any relevant code or config changed in the version that started crashing.

I'd also suggest confirming whether the crash is caused by a missing/incompatible native library, a schema migration issue, or a dependency that changed between versions — a stack trace will usually pin that down quickly.
